h03.

**`github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp`; `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2`**

The abstraction package is `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go`), which defines the shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` contract — the provider-agnostic user-info type that any identity provider must produce (`internal/idp/idp.go:3`).

The one concrete protocol implementation that ships is the OAuth2 provider in `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`). Its package doc states it plainly: *"Package oauth2 implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration."* It defines `IdentityProvider` (`oauth2.go:20`) with `NewIdentityProvider`, `ExchangeToken`, and `UserInfo` — the latter returning the `idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo` from the abstraction package (`oauth2.go:83`, `:114`). OAuth2 is the only subpackage under `internal/idp` (confirmed by directory listing — only `oauth2/` alongside `idp.go`).
